name: executor-cutover-hardening
title: test: 加固 B3 执行段切换的 force/unknown/timeout 语义（票 5bu）
description: 为 B3 切换补三个回归用例：force 重试经执行器产生 attempt=2 且 Gateway 调两次、force 一次性清理；执行器返回 unknown 时主链仍是 publish_result_unknown/result_known=False 且 receipt 为 FAILED(result.status=unknown)、账本 unknown；执行器抛 TimeoutError 时主链 unknown、无 receipt、账本 unknown。纯测试加固。
creator: codex
notes: DONE 2026-11-01 (tests only; no implementation change). B3 (ticket 5bs) cut the approved-publish dispatch over to CreatorAdvisor.execute_action, and three semantics that could silently regress had no direct regression test. Added: (1) test_a_forced_retry_re_executes_through_the_executor — first run succeeds (receipt attempt=1), then a run with publish_options.force_publish=True bypasses the mainline ledger and the executor records attempt=2; asserts the Gateway was invoked twice, attempts are [1, 2], both SUCCEEDED, and the returned publish_options has force_publish cleared (one-shot). (2) test_an_unknown_executor_outcome_keeps_the_mainline_semantics — the Gateway returns a domain status=unknown, the executor records a FAILED receipt whose result status stays unknown, and the mainline still labels the workflow result publish_result_unknown with result_known=False while the mainline ledger record is UNKNOWN (guard stays armed). (3) test_a_timeout_from_the_executor_is_unknown_and_writes_no_receipt — the Gateway raises TimeoutError; the mainline classifies the run as unknown/result_known=False, no receipt is written (the executor propagates before recording), and the mainline ledger record is UNKNOWN. Notes discovered while writing them: the ledger assertions need a real InMemoryStore (mock_store is an AsyncMock and yields no record), and force retries rely on attempt-scoped receipts from 5bq. Verification: three tests green standalone (45.98s); ruff check/format green; full suite in the journal.
